headline: Mauritania Signs Two Offshore Oil Deals with Murphy Oil
summary: Mauritania signed two offshore exploration and production contracts with US firm Murphy Oil for blocks C10 and Tiof.
why: Energy exploration agreements in emerging markets can unlock new hydrocarbon reserves, impacting the long-term asset portfolios and capital expenditure plans of participating exploration companies.
